name: fz553_ghost_curse_no_target
purpose: A Ghost Curse aimed at an ally with no foe standing: Chandelure and Polteageist (p2) faint by their own Memento at step 1 before Trevenant (p1a, Ghost) uses Curse on its ally. The Champions onModifyMove makes the target randomNormal, getRandomTarget draws nothing and returns the fainted foe.active[0] (sim/battle.ts:2512-2521), and useMove shows |move|...|Curse|p2: Chandelure|[notarget] and -fail. On main the engine stopped with E_INVARIANT in dfi_curse_targets (issue 553, fz_334_84). Synthetic teams; the trace is recorded with the pinned Showdown (b2cb775).
